purpose: Define deterministic, socket-valid city and outpost assemblies around the source gatehouse, the contracted operations block, and the planned primary-road modules without producing random masses of unrelated models.

assetReadiness.role: fortified entry, command landmark, and controlled primary-road threshold
blockers: author and verify the through-road and public/service sockets
retopology, LOD, collision, navigation, and semantic material separation

assetReadiness.role: compact staffed operations core with public, vehicle, and service access
blockers: finish and inspect the source candidate
verify every socket clearance and source-hygiene condition
retopology, LOD, collision, navigation, semantic materials, and matched mobile evidence

coordinateAndGridGrammar.originRule: Ground-module and building origins are at footprint center on floor Y=0; portal positions are the bottom-center of the clear opening.
placementOrder: validate connected sockets and authored terminations
reserve road, intersection, visibility, and frontage clearances
add service, pedestrian, and utility links
add bounded props, decals, damage, and infestation last

reservedClearances: continuous 18 m by 16 m primary through-route
12 m deep unobstructed approach fan on both primary-road faces
8 m emergency bypass from service socket to the northern interior apron
no tower buttress, barrier, decal geometry, or collision may enter any socket volume

plotRules: A plot apron is tested against every road and intersection reservation, not only the nearest street.
No required plot may occupy the 28 m by 28 m no-plot center of the primary X plaza.
Public entrances face a public road or concourse; freight and waste faces never substitute for a public entrance.
Service access must reach a map edge or logistics node without crossing a pedestrian-only concourse.
Every structure retains one readable open frontage from tactical and command zoom.

assemblyNotation.placement: Each placement declares an ID, family, center in meters, cardinal yaw, required/optional state, and functional role.
assemblyNotation.connection: Each connection names two placement.socket endpoints. The compiler accepts it only when profiles are compatible, positions match within 0.01 m, outward vectors oppose, and surface step is at most 0.02 m.
assemblyNotation.plot: A plot is an authored footprint plus access and clearance reservations. A model may fill it only when its declared family and podium profile match.
assemblyNotation.optionalSlot: Optional slots select from an explicit ordered family allowlist using the deterministic site hash; an empty state is authored and valid.
assemblyNotation.termination: Every external road socket must mate to another road, a gate/endcap, a declared map boundary, or a damaged authored termination. Unmatched sockets fail validation.

layoutArchetypes.function: Controlled frontier threshold with a staffed command landmark, an operations core, inspection space, and a bypassable service route.
requiredConnections: approach.road_n -> gate.road_s
gate.road_n -> interior.road_s
interior road graph -> authored primary/local adapter -> operations.front_s
gate.public_e -> authored pedestrian concourse -> operations.public_w
operations.rear_n -> service loop -> declared map service boundary
layoutArchetypes.identityRule: The gatehouse is the dominant silhouette; optional structures stay lower than 20 m and may not obscure the portal from the approach.

layoutArchetypes.function: A compact supply node where heavy road traffic, cargo transfer, service maintenance, and operations oversight form a legible loop.

authoredPlacementIntent.role: heavy traffic distributor and no-plot hardstand

requiredConnections: freight_plaza road graph -> authored approach and exit roads on at least three faces
freight_plaza -> primary/local adapter -> operations.front_s
depot cargo socket -> cargo corridor -> bounded loading hardstand
operations.rear_n -> service loop -> depot service entrance
every unused freight-plaza face -> authored road continuation, gate, or map boundary
layoutArchetypes.identityRule: Cargo paths form one obvious loop; tanks, containers, cranes, and maintenance props remain in their assigned yards instead of being scattered across civic frontage.

layoutArchetypes.function: A believable inhabited district block with a public cross-plaza, administrative operations, mixed-height housing/services, and a separate service backplane.
requiredConnections: civic_plaza road sockets -> connected cardinal road graph
operations.front_s -> local-road adapter from the plaza's north spine
operations.public_w and public_e -> occupied pedestrian destinations
all inhabited plots -> public concourse plus independent rear service lane
service lane -> utility block -> declared map service boundary
layoutArchetypes.identityRule: Every 64 m block contains a functionally related low/mid/tall composition; palette swaps do not count as silhouette variety, and no 2x2 area may repeat one building family four times.

layoutArchetypes.function: A hardened base boundary where checkpoint control, unit deployment, maintenance, and personnel spaces remain separated but mutually reachable.
requiredConnections: edge_gate.road_n -> base_spine.road_s
base_spine -> authored corner or T -> deployment heavy apron
operations.front_s -> local spur from base spine
operations.rear_n -> service route -> maintenance and deployment
perimeter wall graph closes or terminates only at authored terrain/map-boundary anchors
layoutArchetypes.identityRule: The deployment route remains visually and physically clear for large units; defenses occupy perimeter frontage, personnel occupy protected interior plots, and no turret or prop blocks a road socket.

layoutArchetypes.function: A major urban arrival sequence that transitions from a primary boulevard through a landmark threshold into a readable public plaza and mixed-use skyline.
requiredConnections: district_gate.road_n -> boulevard.road_s
boulevard.road_n -> arrival_plaza.road_s
arrival_plaza cardinal sockets -> authored streets or explicit district boundaries
district_operations front and public sockets -> local road and occupied concourse destinations
every tower plot -> public frontage plus rear service access that does not cross the plaza
layoutArchetypes.identityRule: The boulevard, gatehouse, plaza, and terminal hero form one visible axis; side towers frame rather than occlude it, and skyline variation comes from authored silhouettes rather than random scale.

deterministicSelection.seedFormula: hash(worldSeed, planetId, regionId, siteId, archetypeId, plotId, kitVersion)
rules: Required placements never roll or disappear.
Optional slots select only from their declared family allowlist and may resolve to an authored empty state.
A deterministic choice still fails when sockets, clearances, material bindings, or evidence fail; a stable bad placement is not acceptable.
Damage and infestation are deterministic post-assembly overlays and may not alter undeclared road topology.

noRandomMassOfModelsRules: Build and validate the complete road graph before placing any structure.
Never scatter buildings from a global list; every model must occupy a named authored plot with a functional-family allowlist.
Never use arbitrary rotation or scale to make a model fit; only cardinal yaw and runtime scale 1 are legal.
Never place a required plot on an intersection, road reservation, sight triangle, gate approach fan, service route, or plaza no-plot zone.
Never allow a road, pipe, tunnel, concourse, door, loading bay, or utility line to terminate without a plausible source, destination, endcap, or map boundary.
Never treat color, decal, mirrored texture, or random greebles as a new silhouette family.
Never repeat one asset in all four plots of a 2x2 block or more than twice adjacently.
Never mix civic, residential, logistics, industrial, and military props outside their declared functional zones.
Never obscure the gatehouse portal, operations frontage, road turn, or plaza topology with optional models or props.

Never admit generated source geometry directly to runtime; source hash, topology, UV/material semantics, collision, navigation, LODs, package allowlist, and matched phone evidence remain separate gates.

blockingCityAndColony: one water or atmosphere utility tower
blockingStatesAndBindings: Brood contact, encroached, and consumed infestation overlays
Aelos, Pyraeth, Nordhall, and Vespera foundation/contact variants
Nova, Dominion, Syndicate, and UGA semantic material/silhouette bindings
LOD0, LOD1, LOD2, and strategic LOD3 or impostor outputs

requiredChecks: every declared asset path/hash/status is truthful
road graph connected before structure placement
every socket profile known and every mate transform valid
every occupied plot has valid public and service access
repetition, silhouette, height-band, and functional-zone rules pass
collision and navigation visualization pass for declared agent classes
matched phone tactical and command captures exist for the same source/runtime fingerprint
